gentle_day_swaps.sore_knee: Sit-to-stand from a higher seat (cushion) and only halfway down; swap the wall sit for seated knee straightening.
gentle_day_swaps.sore_back: Keep the row upright with the towel pull-apart instead of the hinged jug row.
gentle_day_swaps.low_energy: Do one set of everything and the cool-down. That still counts.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

segments.name: Chair sit-to-stand

rebuild.name: Chair sit-to-stand
rebuild.dose: 2 sets of 6, hands on thighs, cushion on the seat
rebuild.how: Put a firm cushion or folded blanket on the seat to make it higher, or push up with your hands on your thighs or on chair arms.
cues: Knees point the same way as your toes. Don't let them cave inward.
Sit down slow. Two or three seconds.
rebuild.breathe: Breathe out as you stand. Breathe in as you sit.

steady.name: Chair sit-to-stand
steady.how: Main version: Cross your arms over your chest, or rest your hands on your thighs. Lean your chest forward, nose over toes.
cues: Knees point the same way as your toes. Don't let them cave inward.
Sit down slow. Two or three seconds.
steady.breathe: Breathe out as you stand. Breathe in as you sit.

strong.name: Chair sit-to-stand
strong.how: Arms crossed, lower for a slow count of three, and pause one second just above the seat before touching down. Later: hold a gallon jug of water at your chest.
cues: Knees point the same way as your toes. Don't let them cave inward.
Sit down slow. Two or three seconds.
strong.breathe: Breathe out as you stand. Breathe in as you sit.

segments.name: Push

rebuild.name: Seated chest press
rebuild.how: Main version: Press the bottles straight out in front of your chest until your arms are straight. Pause one second.
cues: Shoulders down, away from your ears.
Push like you're closing a heavy drawer.
rebuild.equipment: Two water bottles or a light band; sturdy chair against a wall

steady.name: Wall push-up
steady.how: Main version: Bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the wall. Elbows point back at an angle, not straight out.
cues: Body in one straight line, head to heels.
Chest to the wall, not your chin.
steady.breathe: Breathe out as you push away.

strong.name: Wall push-up
strong.how: Step your feet farther back. When 15 are easy, move to counter push-ups.
cues: Body in one straight line, head to heels.
Chest to the wall, not your chin.
strong.breathe: Breathe out as you push away.

iron.name: Counter push-up
iron.how: Lower slowly for three seconds. Later (Iron track): a sturdy low bench or bottom stair, only if the counter version is easy for 12 reps.
cues: Straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your buttocks so your hips don't sag.
iron.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.
safety: Wrist pain? Make fists or hold the counter edge instead of flat palms.
iron.equipment: Kitchen counter (sturdy, not a rolling island)

segments.name: Row

rebuild.name: Seated towel pull-apart
rebuild.how: Main version: Pull your hands apart as hard as you can, like stretching the towel. At the same time, squeeze your shoulder blades together and down.
cues: Shoulders down, away from your ears.
rebuild.breathe: Breathe out as you pull. Never hold your breath.
rebuild.equipment: A hand towel; sturdy chair against a wall

steady.name: One-arm jug row at the counter
steady.dose: 2 sets of 8 each arm, half-gallon jug
steady.how: Main version: Pull the jug up toward your ribs, elbow close to your body. Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
cues: Pull with your elbow, not your hand.
steady.breathe: Breathe out as you pull.
safety: Osteoporosis: keep the hinge small and the back long.
steady.equipment: Kitchen counter + a jug or bag (start with a half-full gallon jug, about 4 pounds)

strong.name: One-arm jug row at the counter
strong.dose: 2 sets of 10 each arm, gallon jug
strong.how: Full gallon jug (about 8 pounds), or a bag with a few cans. Pause for one second at the top.
cues: Pull with your elbow, not your hand.
strong.breathe: Breathe out as you pull.
safety: Osteoporosis: keep the hinge small and the back long.
strong.equipment: Kitchen counter + a jug or bag (start with a half-full gallon jug, about 4 pounds)

iron.name: One-arm jug row at the counter
iron.dose: 3 sets of 10 each arm, gallon jug, 1-second pause
iron.how: Full gallon jug (about 8 pounds), or a bag with a few cans. Pause for one second at the top.
cues: Pull with your elbow, not your hand.
iron.breathe: Breathe out as you pull.
safety: Osteoporosis: keep the hinge small and the back long.
iron.equipment: Kitchen counter + a jug or bag (start with a half-full gallon jug, about 4 pounds)

steady.name: High wall sit
steady.how: Main version: Slide your back down the wall just a few inches, a quarter of the way to sitting. Hold, with your weight in your heels.
cues: Shallow is fine. This is not a contest of depth.

sessions.title: Steady feet
persistent_on_screen: AI character (top-left pill, white on dark, 70% opacity)
Stop if chest pain, dizziness or sharp pain (first 30 s and before each hard block)

track_descriptions.rebuild: Chair-based. Seated, or standing with both hands on the counter and the chair right behind you.
track_descriptions.steady: Standard version with counter or wall support.
track_descriptions.strong: Added load, slower lowering, less hand support.
track_descriptions.iron: For people who already train. Heavier, longer, some moves labelled advanced.

gentle_day_swaps.sore_knee: Keep feet wider and holds shorter; skip the heel-to-toe walk.
gentle_day_swaps.sore_back: Skip the clock reach behind you; reach front and side only.
gentle_day_swaps.low_energy: Weight shifts, heel-to-toe stand and one-leg stand only.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

sessions.caption_movement_addon: Go at your own pace. Hold a counter or chair. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, or sharp pain.
sessions.caption_footer: Chang & Sun are AI characters. Content is educational, built on published research, and not medical advice. Check with your doctor before starting new exercise.

persistent_on_screen: AI character (top-left pill, white on dark, 70% opacity)
Stop if chest pain, dizziness or sharp pain (first 30 s and before each hard block)

track_descriptions.rebuild: Chair-based. Seated, or standing with both hands on the counter and the chair right behind you.
track_descriptions.steady: Standard version with counter or wall support.
track_descriptions.strong: Added load, slower lowering, less hand support.
track_descriptions.iron: For people who already train. Heavier, longer, some moves labelled advanced.

gentle_day_swaps.sore_knee: Replace step-ups with seated knee straightening; power stands from a higher seat, normal speed.
gentle_day_swaps.sore_back: Use the seated hinge instead of the jug pick-up; carry one light bag only.
gentle_day_swaps.low_energy: Do the power stands, the curls and the carry. One set each.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

sessions.caption_movement_addon: Go at your own pace. Hold a counter or chair. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, or sharp pain.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.

safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

track_descriptions.rebuild: Chair-based. Seated, or standing with both hands on the counter and the chair right behind you.

gentle_day_swaps.sore_knee: Higher seat and half range for sit-to-stands; seated knee straightening instead of the split squat and wall sit.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

persistent_on_screen: AI character (top-left pill, white on dark, 70% opacity)
Stop if chest pain, dizziness or sharp pain (first 30 s and before each hard block)

track_descriptions.rebuild: Chair-based. Seated, or standing with both hands on the counter and the chair right behind you.
track_descriptions.steady: Standard version with counter or wall support.
track_descriptions.strong: Added load, slower lowering, less hand support.
track_descriptions.iron: For people who already train. Heavier, longer, some moves labelled advanced.

gentle_day_swaps.sore_knee: Skip the figure-4 and the hip-front stretch; extra ankle circles.
gentle_day_swaps.sore_back: Chin tucks, wall slides and breathing only.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

sessions.caption_movement_addon: Go at your own pace. Hold a counter or chair. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, or sharp pain.
sessions.caption_footer: Chang & Sun are AI characters. Content is educational, built on published research, and not medical advice. Check with your doctor before starting new exercise.

Stop if chest pain, dizziness or sharp pain (first 30 s and before each hard block)

track_descriptions.rebuild: Chair-based. Seated, or standing with both hands on the counter and the chair right behind you.
track_descriptions.steady: Standard version with counter or wall support.
track_descriptions.strong: Added load, slower lowering, less hand support.
track_descriptions.iron: For people who already train. Heavier, longer, some moves labelled advanced.

gentle_day_swaps.sore_knee: Skip the step-overs; weight shifts and heel-to-toe stand instead.
gentle_day_swaps.low_energy: Toe and heel walks, heel-to-toe stand.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

sessions.caption_movement_addon: Go at your own pace. Hold a counter or chair. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, or sharp pain.
sessions.caption_footer: Chang & Sun are AI characters. Content is educational, built on published research, and not medical advice. Check with your doctor before starting new exercise.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.

track_descriptions.rebuild: Chair-based. Seated, or standing with both hands on the counter and the chair right behind you.

track_descriptions.strong: Added load, slower lowering, less hand support.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

sessions.caption_movement_addon: Go at your own pace. Hold a counter or chair. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, or sharp pain.

track_descriptions.rebuild: Chair-based. Seated, or standing with both hands on the counter and the chair right behind you.
track_descriptions.steady: Standard version with counter or wall support.
track_descriptions.strong: Added load, slower lowering, less hand support.
track_descriptions.iron: For people who already train. Heavier, longer, some moves labelled advanced.

gentle_day_swaps.sore_knee: Skip the step test and the Up and Go today; do them another day.
gentle_day_swaps.low_energy: Do the chair stand and balance only; finish the rest tomorrow.

safety_global.stop_rule: Stop if you feel chest pain or pressure, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or sharp pain.
safety_global.emergency: Chest pain, face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking? Call 911 now.
safety_global.pain_rule: Mild discomfort up to 3 out of 10 is okay if it settles by tomorrow. Sharper, or worse the next day: back off and ask your doctor or physical therapist.
safety_global.stand_slowly: Sit a moment before you stand, then stand slowly while holding something steady.

guided_tests.caption_movement_addon: Go at your own pace. Hold a counter or chair. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, or sharp pain.
